newsitem.title: USA: Charter Power says requests change of name.
newsitem.headline: Charter Power says requests change of name.

text.p: Charter Power Systems Inc said Tuesday it asked its shareholders to approve a change in the company's name to C&D Technologies Inc.

In a proxy statement sent to shareholders last week, the company said the new name more accurately reflects the nature of its technology-driven business and incorporates the "C&D" logotype which has appeared on most of its products since the company's founding over 90 years ago.
Shareholders will vote on the name change at the company's annual meeting on June 24 in Philadelphia.
Charter Power produces and markets electrical power storage and conversion products used in telecommunications, computers and office equipment.
